m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: ASML在極紫外光刻（EUV）技術領域擁有全球獨家供應地位，其設備是製造最先進半導體晶片的關鍵。這賦予了ASML無與倫比的定價權，客戶即使面對高昂的設備價格，也別無選擇，因為沒有替代品能達到相同的技術水平。這種壟斷性地位確保了公司能夠將成本上升轉嫁給客戶，並維持高利潤率，這正是巴菲特所推崇的「收費橋樑」型企業特徵。其產品的不可替代性，使得客戶對價格的敏感度極低，為公司帶來持續且強勁的盈利能力。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: ASML holds a global monopoly in Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography technology, making its equipment indispensable for manufacturing the most advanced semiconductor chips. This grants ASML unparalleled pricing power; customers, despite high equipment costs, have no viable alternatives to achieve the required technological sophistication. This monopolistic position ensures the company can pass on cost increases and maintain high-profit margins, embodying Buffett's "toll bridge" business characteristic. The irreplaceable nature of its products renders customers highly inelastic to price changes, securing sustained and robust profitability for the company.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: ASML在光刻技術領域，特別是極紫外光（EUV）方面，累積了數十年、數十億美元的研發投入，形成了龐大且難以逾越的專利集群。這些專利不僅涵蓋了核心技術，還包括了製造工藝、材料科學等各個環節，構建了極高的法律壁壘，使得任何潛在競爭者幾乎不可能在短期內複製其技術。此外，EUV設備的戰略重要性也使其受到嚴格的國際貿易法規和出口管制，進一步鞏固了其市場地位，形成了一種事實上的特許經營權，這是巴菲特眼中極具價值的護城河。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: ASML has invested decades and billions of dollars in R&D, particularly in Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography, resulting in an extensive and formidable patent portfolio. These patents cover not only core technologies but also manufacturing processes and material science, creating substantial legal barriers that make it virtually impossible for potential competitors to replicate its technology in the short term. Furthermore, the strategic importance of EUV equipment subjects it to stringent international trade regulations and export controls, further solidifying its market position and effectively granting it a de facto franchise, a highly valued moat in Buffett's view.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 對於半導體製造商而言，導入ASML的極紫外光刻（EUV）設備是一項耗資巨大且極其複雜的工程。這不僅涉及數億美元的單機成本，更需要對廠房基礎設施進行大規模改造、培訓高度專業化的操作與維護團隊，並將其深度整合到整個晶片生產流程中。一旦投入使用，轉換至其他供應商的設備將意味著天文數字般的重新投資、漫長的製程驗證期以及潛在的生產中斷和巨大營收損失。這種極高的轉換成本，使得客戶對ASML產品產生了強烈的依賴性，構成了堅不可摧的護城河。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: For semiconductor manufacturers, integrating ASML's Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography equipment is an immensely costly and complex undertaking. It involves not only hundreds of millions of dollars per machine but also extensive fab infrastructure modifications, training highly specialized operational and maintenance teams, and deep integration into the entire chip production workflow. Once deployed, switching to alternative suppliers would entail astronomical reinvestment, lengthy process requalification periods, and potential production disruptions with significant revenue losses. These exceptionally high switching costs create profound customer dependency on ASML's products, forming an unassailable economic moat.

m4_network_effects.comment_zh: ASML的護城河並非典型的網絡效應，即「用戶越多，產品價值越高」。然而，其在極紫外光刻（EUV）領域的獨佔地位，確實催生了一個圍繞EUV技術的龐大生態系統。全球頂尖的晶片製造商、材料供應商、研發機構都必須圍繞ASML的技術標準和設備進行協同開發與優化。這種生態系統的形成，使得ASML成為行業的「事實標準」，任何新進入者都難以在沒有ASML支持的情況下，建立起同樣完善的產業鏈協作。這種間接的生態系統鎖定，雖非傳統網絡效應，卻也強化了其市場地位。
m4_network_effects.comment_en: ASML's moat isn't a typical network effect where "more users enhance product value." However, its monopolistic position in Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography has fostered a vast ecosystem centered around EUV technology. Top-tier chip manufacturers, material suppliers, and R&D institutions globally must align their development and optimization efforts with ASML's technical standards and equipment. This ecosystem establishes ASML as the industry's "de facto standard," making it incredibly difficult for new entrants to build a comparable supply chain collaboration without ASML's support. This indirect ecosystem lock-in, while not a traditional network effect, significantly reinforces its market dominance.

m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_zh: ASML在極紫外光刻（EUV）技術的研發上投入了數十年、數百億歐元的巨額資金，這種規模的投入本身就構成了極高的進入壁壘。其生產的EUV設備集成了全球最尖端的精密光學、機械、真空和軟體技術，製造過程極其複雜，需要獨特的專業知識、高度專業化的供應鏈管理以及無與倫比的工藝精準度。這種極致的規模經濟和獨家工藝良率，使得ASML能夠提供競爭對手無法企及的性能和可靠性，並在成本結構上形成巨大優勢，確保其在高端市場的絕對領導地位。
m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_en: ASML has invested tens of billions of euros over decades in the research and development of Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography technology, an investment scale that itself forms an immense barrier to entry. Its EUV machines integrate the world's most advanced precision optics, mechanics, vacuum, and software technologies. The manufacturing process is incredibly complex, demanding unique expertise, highly specialized supply chain management, and unparalleled process precision. This extreme scale economy and exclusive process yield enable ASML to deliver performance and reliability unmatched by competitors, creating a significant cost structure advantage and ensuring its absolute leadership in the high-end market.

m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_zh: 極紫外光刻（EUV）設備市場是一個典型的利基市場，其客戶群體僅限於全球少數幾家頂尖的半導體製造巨頭。這個市場的容量相對有限，但對技術的要求卻是天文數字級別。任何潛在的新進入者，即使擁有雄厚資本，也將面臨數十年、數百億美元的研發投入，卻只能服務於一個極為有限的客戶群。這種「高效規模」的特性，使得市場自然形成寡頭壟斷，新競爭者的加入只會導致所有參與者利潤率的急劇下降，從而形成一種天然的理性寡占，鞏固了ASML的市場主導地位。
m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_en: The Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography equipment market is a classic niche, serving only a handful of the world's leading semiconductor manufacturing giants. While market capacity is relatively limited, the technological demands are astronomical. Any potential new entrant, even with substantial capital, would face decades and tens of billions of dollars in R&D investment for an extremely restricted customer base. This "efficient scale" characteristic naturally leads to an oligopoly, where the entry of new competitors would only drastically reduce profit margins for all participants, thus forming a natural, rational oligopoly that solidifies ASML's market dominance.

m7_operational_efficiency.comment_zh: ASML展現出驚人的資本回報能力，其股東權益報酬率（ROE）高達62.5%，資產報酬率（ROA）亦達23.4%，遠超行業平均水平。這強烈表明公司能夠持續將投入資本轉化為豐厚利潤，且其投入資本回報率（ROIC）長期顯著高於加權平均資本成本（WACC）。這種卓越的資本效率和持續的超額回報能力，是其堅固護城河的直接財務體現。它證明了ASML不僅擁有強大的定價權和技術壁壘，更能將這些優勢轉化為實質的股東價值創造，符合巴菲特對優質企業的嚴格標準。
m7_operational_efficiency.comment_en: ASML demonstrates astonishing capital returns, with an Equity Return (ROE) of 62.5% and an Asset Return (ROA) of 23.4%, significantly exceeding industry averages. This strongly indicates the company's sustained ability to convert invested capital into substantial profits, with its Return on Invested Capital (ROIC) consistently and significantly surpassing its Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) over the long term. This exceptional capital efficiency and sustained excess return capability are direct financial manifestations of its robust economic moat. It proves that ASML not only possesses strong pricing power and technological barriers but also translates these advantages into tangible shareholder value creation, meeting Buffett's stringent criteria for a quality business.

m8_capital_allocation.comment_zh: ASML的極紫外光刻（EUV）技術是數十年來，全球頂尖科學家和工程師投入數百億美元、歷經無數次失敗與突破才得以實現的結晶。其核心戰略資產不僅是專利和設備，更包括了獨特的知識體系、高度專業化的供應鏈、與客戶深度綁定的合作關係以及無可替代的人才庫。即使給予任何競爭對手一千億美元的巨額資金，也無法在短短幾年內複製ASML所建立的技術深度、工藝精準度與市場生態位。這種資本和時間都無法複製的特性，是其最堅不可摧的護城河之一。
m8_capital_allocation.comment_en: ASML's Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography technology is the culmination of decades of effort, billions of dollars, and countless failures and breakthroughs by the world's top scientists and engineers. Its core strategic assets extend beyond patents and equipment to include a unique knowledge base, a highly specialized supply chain, deeply embedded customer relationships, and an irreplaceable talent pool. Even if a competitor were given a staggering one hundred billion dollars, it would be impossible to replicate ASML's technological depth, process precision, and market niche within just a few years. This irreproducibility by capital and time is one of its most formidable moats.

m9_customer_retention.comment_zh: ASML的極紫外光刻（EUV）技術是當前及可預見未來，製造最先進半導體晶片的基石。儘管科技日新月異，但目前尚無任何已知或可行的替代技術，能在中短期內完全取代光刻在大規模、高密度晶片生產中的核心地位。ASML的技術是數位時代的基礎設施，其需求確定性極高。即使未來出現「典範轉移」，也極大可能是在光刻技術的框架內進行演進，而ASML作為行業領導者，將會是這項新技術的主要推動者和受益者，而非被顛覆者，因此具備強大的技術變革抗性。
m9_customer_retention.comment_en: ASML's Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography technology is the cornerstone for manufacturing the most advanced semiconductor chips, both currently and for the foreseeable future. Despite rapid technological advancements, there are no known or viable alternative technologies capable of completely displacing lithography's central role in high-volume, high-density chip production in the near to medium term. ASML's technology is fundamental infrastructure for the digital age, ensuring extremely high demand certainty. Even if a "paradigm shift" occurs, it is highly likely to be an evolution within the lithography framework, with ASML, as the industry leader, being the primary driver and beneficiary of such new technology, rather than being disrupted. Thus, it possesses strong immunity to technological change.

m10_durability.comment_zh: ASML的管理層展現了卓越的資本配置能力。公司持續將大量自由現金流投入到前瞻性研發中，確保其技術領先地位，並進行了如收購Cymer等關鍵戰略性併購，以鞏固核心技術供應鏈。同時，ASML也積極透過股息和股票回購將資本回報給股東，尤其在市場低估時進行回購，有效提升了每股價值。其強勁的資產負債表（現金遠超負債）和高自由現金流，證明了管理層在維持財務健康與最大化股東利益之間的平衡與智慧，符合巴菲特對優秀管理層的期望。
m10_durability.comment_en: ASML's management has demonstrated exceptional capital allocation capabilities. The company consistently reinvests substantial free cash flow into forward-looking R&D, ensuring its technological leadership, and has made key strategic acquisitions, such as Cymer, to solidify its core technology supply chain. Concurrently, ASML actively returns capital to shareholders through dividends and share buybacks, particularly when the market undervalues the stock, effectively enhancing per-share value. Its robust balance sheet (cash significantly exceeding debt) and high free cash flow attest to management's balance and wisdom in maintaining financial health while maximizing shareholder interests, aligning with Buffett's expectations for excellent management.

moat.overall_moat_verdict_zh: ASML無疑是巴菲特眼中極為罕見的「特許經營權」型企業，其護城河之深廣，在全球範圍內亦屬鳳毛麟角。公司憑藉在極紫外光刻（EUV）技術上的絕對壟斷地位，成為全球最先進半導體晶片製造的唯一「收費橋樑」。其護城河由數十年、數百億美元的研發投入所築成的專利集群、極高的客戶轉換成本、難以複製的規模經濟與工藝精準度，以及天然寡占的利基市場共同構成。這使得ASML擁有無與倫比的定價權和持續超額的資本回報能力，確保其在可預見的未來能持續創造巨大股東價值，是典型的「好生意」。
moat.overall_moat_verdict_en: ASML is undoubtedly a rare "franchise" business in Buffett's view, possessing an economic moat of exceptional depth and breadth, truly unique on a global scale. The company, through its absolute monopolistic position in Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography technology, serves as the sole "toll bridge" for the manufacturing of the world's most advanced semiconductor chips. Its moat is constructed from a patent cluster built over decades with tens of billions of dollars in R&D investment, extremely high customer switching costs, irreplicable economies of scale and process precision, and a naturally oligopolistic niche market. This grants ASML unparalleled pricing power and sustained excess returns on capital, ensuring its ability to continuously create immense shareholder value for the foreseeable future, epitomizing a "great business."

stock.description: ASML Holding N.V. provides lithography solutions for the development, production, marketing, sales, upgrading, and servicing of advanced semiconductor equipment systems. The company offers lithography, metrology, and inspection systems. It also provides extreme ultraviolet lithography systems; and deep ultraviolet lithography systems comprising immersion and dry lithography systems solutions to manufacture various range of semiconductor nodes and technologies. In addition, the company offers metrology and inspection systems, including YieldStar optical metrology systems, a diffraction-based wafer metrology platform to assess the quality of patterns on the wafers; and HMI electron beam solutions to locate and analyze individual chip defects. Further, it provides computational lithography solutions, and lithography systems and control software solutions; and refurbishes and upgrades lithography systems, as well as offers customer support and related services. Additionally, the company offers hardware, software, and services to chipmakers to produce the patterns of integrated circuits. It operates in Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Taiwan, China, rest of Asia, the Netherlands, rest of Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the United States. The company was formerly known as ASM Lithography Holding N.V. and changed its name to ASML Holding N.V. in 2001. ASML Holding N.V. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Veldhoven, the Netherlands.

stock.description_zh:
ASML Holding N.V. (艾司摩爾) 提供先進半導體設備系統的微影解決方案，涵蓋從研發、製造、銷售、升級到服務的完整方案。其核心產品線包含微影、量測及檢測系統。

關鍵技術有極紫外光(EUV)微影系統，以及深紫外光(DUV)微影系統（含浸潤式及乾式），用於不同世代半導體製程與技術節點。在量測與檢測領域，提供YieldStar光學量測系統（應用繞射原理評估晶圓圖案），以及HMI電子束缺陷檢測解決方案（精準定位分析晶片瑕疵）。

ASML亦提供計算微影解決方案、與微影系統控制軟體，並提供設備翻新、升級與客戶支援服務，協助晶圓廠精確蝕刻積體電路圖案。業務遍及全球主要半導體市場，為晶片生產供應鏈之核心供應商。
